title: mikania psilostachya var. scabra
intro: Mikania psilostachya var. scabra, commonly known as a type of plant in the Asteraceae family, is a perennial species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Mikania psilostachya var. scabra are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiseptic properties, which make it effective in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
